_help: Keyed by December date (MM-DD). On each day he wears the most recent entry on or before today. hat / neck / hand are item ids from wardrobe.js ('none' = nothing). 'say' is said once when he wakes up that day. {kid} = Balder, {sleeps} = sleeps until Christmas Eve.

12-01.say: December is here! Only {sleeps} sleeps until Christmas Eve!

12-03.say: It gets dark so early... good thing I have my lantern!

12-06.say: I found a present! Is it for you, {kid}?

12-09.say: Today I'm a reindeer! Have you seen my sleigh?

12-13.say: Happy Lucia day! Look at my candles!

12-16.say: Rice pudding! With a BIG lump of butter!
